description: Inputs: validation-partition tensors of the 19F feature cache (featurize.py --nucleus 19F), 7 molecules chosen at evenly spaced ranks of (node count, record); 'record' is the molecule's record number in the node/f19/build.ts extraction. Expected: the outputs of 19F.fp16.onnx (fp16-stored weights) under onnxruntime 1.19.2 on the CPU, float32. 'features' is the schema-1 feature record of the extraction's feature dump packed into each case's tensors (py/featurize.py), so the plugin's packer can be checked against the Python packing.
